06326 Puw`ah {poo-aw'}

字根已不使用, 意為 光輝炫麗; 陰性專有名詞 人名

AV - Puah 1; 1

普阿 = "耀目的"
1) 摩西時代被埃及法老指派要把所有新生的以色列男嬰都殺死的兩個接生婆之一
record.edic_text:
06326 Puw`ah {poo-aw'}

from an unused root meaning to glitter;; n pr f

AV - Puah 1; 1

Puah = "splendid"
1) one of the 2 midwives of the Hebrews ordered by Pharaoh to kill
   all the male children born to Israel; time of Moses
